name: spsm
description: St. Philopater Mercurius & St. Mina — website, PWA, and shared Firebase backend

scripts.//dev: The everyday one: the website at http://localhost:3000. Builds @spsm/shared first because the app imports its compiled dist/, not its TypeScript source.
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run dev --workspace @spsm/website
scripts.//dev:https: The same as `dev`, over HTTPS. Use this to work on checkout: browsers only offer a saved card on a secure origin. Pair it with `dev:backend` in another terminal so the payment POST has a Function to reach.
scripts.dev:https: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run dev:https --workspace @spsm/website
scripts.//dev:backend: Emulator suite, for rules and Cloud Functions work. Unrelated to `dev` — the website talks to the real Firestore, not the emulator.
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run build --workspace @spsm/functions && npm run emulators
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.//verify:scopes: Checks every credential in .env against the live services, and that the two external service accounts are scoped the way docs/integrations.md claims.
scripts.//audit:secrets: Looks for every credential in .env in two places it must never be: anything git tracks, and anything the build wrote. Never prints a value — a finding names the variable and the file. Pairs with verify:scopes, which asks whether a credential still works; this asks whether anyone else can see it. Run a build first for the fuller check, and exit code 1 means stop.
scripts.//bulletin: Prints this week's bulletin exactly as the site build reads it. First stop when the homepage bulletin section is missing.
scripts.//config: Shows config/integrations, config/parish, config/theme and config/camp; --write creates any that are missing from the committed defaults. Narrow it with --only=camp.
scripts.//content: Pushes content/*.md into the Firestore `content` collection. Dry run by default; -- --write applies.
scripts.//programs: Creates the five standing programs (Summercamp, St. Simon, College & YP, Mother of Mercy, Iconography) if they are missing. Never overwrites — admins edit these in the console. Dry run by default; -- --write applies.
scripts.//forms: Creates the parish's four forms if they are absent, and never overwrites one that exists — staff edit these in the drawer on /forms. Vehicle registration is created published (it replaces the old /parking form); the three rebuilt Breeze forms are drafts until the parish takes the Breeze originals down.
scripts.//forms:subjects: Appends any "What is this about?" option the built-in contact form has and the stored one lacks — the second of the two writes a new option needs. Dry run by default; --write applies. Never renames, reorders, or removes.
scripts.//forms:pictures: Gives a built-in form the picture its code default names, but only where the stored form has none — the second of the two writes a new default picture needs. Never replaces a picture staff chose; change those in the drawer on /forms. Dry run by default; --write applies.
scripts.//parish:geo: Writes config/parish.geo, the point the map on /contact is centred on. Geocodes the stored address against OpenStreetMap unless you pass --lat/--lng. Dry run by default; -- --write applies. Look at /contact afterwards — a swapped pair is a legal point somewhere else and nothing can catch it for you.
scripts.//catalog: Mirror the Square bookstore catalog into Firestore products.
scripts.//orders:backfill: Gives every existing order a lowercased contactEmailLower, which is the field the buyer-facing order lookup queries. Orders taken before that field existed are otherwise invisible to it. Dry run by default; --write applies.
scripts.//archive: Refresh the committed snapshot of past livestreams.
scripts.//assets: Rebuilds the web-ready images in public/ and app/ from the originals in assets/. Run after adding a photo; --check verifies the committed outputs exist.
scripts.//logos: One-off, for /about/future-plans: cuts the consultants' logo sheet into one PNG per firm. Reads the sheet off the macOS clipboard — copy the image, run this, then `npm run assets`. Pass a path instead if the sheet is saved somewhere. See scripts/slice-logo-sheet.mjs.
scripts.//dev:local: The whole site against the emulators, with sample data and sign-in-able accounts. The only way to work on the servants entries in /calendar, or on editing anything in place, since both need a role and the real project only grants one to the parish directory.
scripts.dev:local: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && node scripts/seed-emulator.mjs && NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_EMULATORS=1 npm run dev --workspace @spsm/website
scripts.//seed:emulator: Re-fills the emulators without restarting the dev server.
scripts.//backfill:screens: Adds the screenAdmin map to member documents written before per-screen permissions existed. Dry run by default; -- --write applies. Grants nothing — every screen is written false.
scripts.//prayer:remove: Deletes what the removed prayer request feature left in Firestore: the forms/prayer-requests definition and the sealed prayerRequests collection. Dry run by default; -- --write applies, and there is no undo. Pass --keep-requests to delete only the form definition.
scripts.//grant-admin: Bootstraps the first admin by email. setMemberRole needs an admin to call it, and at the start nobody is one.
scripts.//test: Pure functions from @spsm/shared. No emulator, no network, no credentials — runs in about a second, so there is no excuse not to.
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @spsm/shared && vitest run --project unit
scripts.//test:rules: firestore.rules evaluated against a real emulator. This is the one that would have caught decision #10 on day one; `rules:check` only compiles. Needs a JDK.
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-spsm "vitest run --project rules"
